title: mamori.audit-line/1
description:
One line of a mamori audit file. An envelope around a mamori.protection-scope record, and nothing more. It exists because the question the audit file answers -- what left this machine last Tuesday -- needs a time, and a protection-scope record cannot carry one: ADR 0032 says a record states what is derivable from the artifact it describes, and when a protection happened is a fact about the event rather than the text. So the time lives out here, where this format owns it, and the contract inside stays frozen. ENCODING: UTF-8, and a file is one such line per protection separated by 
 (JSON Lines). A contract that does not name its encoding is one its own producer eventually gets wrong.

line.description: This format's identifier. Versioned separately from the record's contract because the two change for unrelated reasons: this one is a file format, that one is a statement about a document.

at.description: When the protection happened, UTC, to the millisecond. UTC because a file saying 09:15 and not which 09:15 is a file two people read differently; milliseconds because two protections in the same second are ordinary and a JSON Lines file has no ordering other than the order of its lines.

record.description: A mamori.protection-scope record, validated against its own schema before it is written. This schema does not restate its shape: a second copy of a frozen contract is a second thing to keep in step.

$comment: What this format does NOT say, and cannot: who wrote the line. 'by' inside the record is a producer's claim about itself, and a schema states the shape of a document, never its author. A file treated as evidence of what one machine did needs that established some other way.
